content: GST 2.0 effective 22 Sep 2025: slabs cut to 5%/18% plus 40% sin slab; compensation cess removed for most goods Sep 2025, for tobacco 1 Feb 2026. Month-M collections reflect M-1 transactions. Sept 2025 supplies postponed, Oct-Nov 2025 collections weak; Oct 2026 gross GST +22.9% YoY (base effect), imports +42%, domestic +16%. Monthly PIB press release stopped after June 2024; data on GST portal; state-wise later reported again.
